title: Comparative Study of a Variant Neural Relational Inference Deep Learning Model and Dynamical Network Analysis for p53-DNA Allosteric Interactions.
authors: Sun, Haoxin; Wei, Jingbo; Tang, Yiming; Guo, Tianjing; Wei, Guanghong; Lei, Jiangtao
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合改进的NRI深度学习模型与动态网络分析，系统比较p53-DNA别构互作通路，聚焦突变对长程别构信号传递及DNA结合的影响，高度契合TF-DNA互作机制建模课题。
abstract: Protein allostery is a critical regulatory mechanism in various biological processes, representing a challenging aspect of biological research. Dynamical network analysis serves as a foundational computational methodology for studying allosteric effects, while the recent emergence of neural relational inference (NRI) model has introduced novel insights into understanding it. In this study, we modified NRI model by integrating the multi-head self-attention module of transformer, and then compared the variant model with dynamical network analysis and initial NRI model for p53-DNA allosteric interactions. Our results show that the variant model is more focused on long-range allosteric than dynamical network in predicting p53-DNA allosteric pathways, and enhances superior accuracy and comprehensiveness compared to initial NRI model. Moreover, divergent allosteric pathways in wild-type (WT) versus mutant (MT) p53 may underlie their substantially different DNA recognition and binding behaviors. Finally, we found that even with undefined ending nodes, allosteric pathways consistently propagate from mutation sites toward DNA, and the length of pathways in MT p53 is significantly longer than that of WT p53. These suggest that mutation sites impair long-range allosteric communication, potentially disrupting signal transmission efficiency. Our results offer novel insights for a deep understanding of protein allosteric pathways through different methods.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质别构（protein allostery）是多种生物过程中的关键调控机制，也是生物学研究中具有挑战性的方面。动力学网络分析（dynamical network analysis）作为研究别构效应的基础计算方法，而近期出现的神经关系推断（neural relational inference, NRI）模型为其理解引入了新见解。在本研究中，我们通过整合Transformer的多头自注意力模块对NRI模型进行了改进，并将该变体模型与动力学网络分析及初始NRI模型在p53-DNA别构相互作用中进行了比较。结果表明，在预测p53-DNA别构通路时，变体模型比动力学网络更侧重于长程别构效应，并且相较于初始NRI模型，其准确性和全面性均有显著提升。此外，野生型（WT）与突变型（MT）p53中不同的别构通路可能解释了它们DNA识别和结合行为的显著差异。最后，我们发现即使终点节点未定义，别构通路也始终从突变位点向DNA方向传播，且MT p53中通路的长度显著长于WT p53。这些结果表明，突变位点削弱了长程别构通讯，可能干扰信号传递效率。我们的结果为通过不同方法深入理解蛋白质别构通路提供了新见解。
